about: Every gift: price, where it is sold, and who loves or really likes it. Source of truth for the site's gift picks and for gifts.md. Meal rules live in gifts-and-meals.md.

conventions.price: Game8 base price in G, before the Gifts Discount boon. Other guides list some prices about 10% lower (27G pastries, 45G Young Ghosh, 90G coffee, 135G ghosh): that is the boon price.
conventions.tiers: loved = two gold arrows (about double gain); really = 'They really liked it'. Game8 lists only these two tiers; Fextralife's table agrees on the loved lists.
conventions.sold: shop is a Dagsion vendor (see shops), a peddler, or a World Map settlement. from = first chapter it is stocked, when known. conf: player = seen in this player's game; unconfirmed = not in the current Game8 merchant list.
conventions.dagsion: Gift Vendor and Market Vendor are in Dagsion and cost no Turns. Settlements cost Turns unless the route already goes there.
conventions.lovedUnconfirmed: Raider King marks some loved gifts "?" (not verified in game): those units sit in lovedUnconfirmed, not loved.
conventions.characters: characters: per unit, the gift categories it likes (catalog `likes` keys), a few specific extras and exceptions (`not`). Use it for any item the catalog doesn't tag yet: a gift in a liked category is at least liked. Item-level loved/really lists win over categories.

rules: One gift per character per week; resets Sunday. No Turn cost.
The first gift only opens the bond (meals, recruit terms). Use the cheapest item: Simple or Mellow Pastries, 30G, Lowtown.
A birthday gift counts as at least really liked.
Stock is limited per restock: usually one copy before it refills.
Five reactions: not liked (0), kind of liked, liked, really liked, really liked with two yellow arrows (double: loved).
open_questions: Prices: Game8 lists round prices (30, 50, 100, 150G); Fextralife and older notes list ~10% less. Treated as base vs Gifts Discount price.
Market Vendor additions by chapter are unknown. Eastern Love Story, Gaudy Bangle and Training Bracelet were tied to it by an older Game8 parse; current Game8 lists no merchant.

Protection Figurine, Coffee Pastries, Strong Seasonings and Mane Ornament were listed in Dagsion by older Game8 pages; current Game8 sells them only in settlements (Niiza Port, Megaira, Callianeira Port/Kira, Grand Aragon).
Game8 and Fextralife disagree on really-liked lists for Young Ghosh, Young Shosh and Crimson Ghosh; Game8 is used.
RaiderKing lists paintings (Pegasus Panorama, Shield Portrait, Flower Painting, Portrait of Yu Phas) as loved by many; Game8 and Fextralife list no recipients. Not used for picks.
